Swap Tokens

MEV Protected

Anti-MEV Protection

On by default. Caps slippage at 0.5%, blocks swaps with price impact above 5%, and shortens the swap deadline to 2 minutes. Every swap — with Anti-MEV on or off — is also re-quoted fresh and simulated right before your transaction is sent.

Honest note: this reduces the risk of sandwich attacks and frontrunning, but it cannot guarantee 100% MEV-free swaps. Loop's Uniswap V2 has no private mempool, so your transaction is still publicly visible before it confirms.

The router is picked automatically from the pool's own factory, per token — never one router for everything. Corrected pools (Gen-3/4/5 graduations) route through Router02 (Corrected): the 0.3% fee splits 0.10% to the pool · 0.05% creator · 0.15% platform, plus creator tax, with every fee settled in LOOP, and quotes come from that router itself because sell quotes are net of the LOOP skim. Fee-split pools split 0.20% pool · 0.05% creator · 0.05% platform, taken from your input; legacy pools keep the full 0.3% inside the pool. Every swap uses the router's fee-on-transfer–supporting swap functions (so tokens with a creator / transfer tax can swap), is re-quoted fresh right before sending, and is simulated with eth_call first — if the simulation says the swap would fail, nothing is sent and the real reason is shown. Stablecoins (tUSDC, tUSDT) and the 12 test xStocks trade through TestAssetPeg v2 at the USD oracle price with a single 0.5% spread per swap — there are no V2 pools for xStocks. Graduated tokens can also pair with tUSDC/tUSDT in the Gen-7 factory once a stable pair exists; until then the form says the pair does not exist yet.

Set a target market cap for a graduated token. Your funds move into the SakuraLimitOrder contract, which holds them until a keeper fills the order at your target — or you cancel and get a full refund.

How execution works — please read: orders are created on-chain in the SakuraLimitOrder contract (0xa28656…16d52) and your funds are held by that contract — an order stays live even if you close this page. It is not filled instantly: a keeper executes it once the pool price reaches your target, and the keeper takes a 1% fee, always paid in LOOP. A 24/7 keeper is running, so a reached order is executed automatically. You can cancel any open order at any time and the contract refunds your funds in full.

Your Orders

Split one total amount into equal orders on a fixed schedule, so your average entry price smooths out over time instead of depending on one moment. The full budget moves into the SakuraDCA contract up front.

How execution works — please read: plans are created on-chain in the SakuraDCA contract (0x44d10d…e7d1Dd) and the contract holds the budget — a plan keeps its schedule even if you close this page. Each order is executed by a keeper when it comes due (the first order is due immediately), not instantly by this page, and the keeper takes a 1% fee, always paid in LOOP, from each swap. A 24/7 keeper is running, so due orders are executed automatically. You can cancel a plan at any time and the contract refunds whatever is left.

Lock Token

Pick a token you hold, then set the amount and lock duration. The tokens move into the locker contract and can only be withdrawn once the unlock time arrives.

Or type your own lock duration in days (1–3650).

Token
Amount
Withdrawable from

Locking is final until the unlock time: the amount and date cannot be changed, moved earlier, or cancelled — by anyone, including the lock creator.

How It Works & Security

The locker is designed with no exploitable loopholes — its contract is deployed on-chain at 0xA4C46795Bc6116e0286ea13e1439622E9727B50f and works on these principles:

  • Only the owner can withdraw, and only after the unlock time is reached. There are no shortcuts.
  • No admin functions — no contract owner, no emergency function, nobody who can move or freeze someone else's lock.
  • The unlock time cannot be moved earlier and the locked amount cannot be changed once a lock is created.
  • Anti-reentrancy — withdrawals use the checks-effects-interactions pattern plus a reentrancy guard, and token transfers use SafeERC20.
  • All locks are recorded on-chain (Locked/Withdrawn events), so prospective buyers can verify the locked amount and unlock date of any token claimed to be locked themselves.

Do not send tokens to any address claiming to be SakuraPad farming before the official contract is announced on this page.

How Farming Will Work

  1. 1Pick a farm. Once farms are live, each graduated token's farm will be listed below with its reward token and duration.
  2. 2Stake your tokens. Deposit the graduated token into the farming contract from this page — you keep full control until you confirm the transaction in your wallet.
  3. 3Earn & claim. Rewards build up while your tokens stay staked, and you claim them or withdraw your stake from this same page.

What You Can Stake

Farming is being prepared as direct token staking for tokens that have graduated to Uniswap V2 — not LP staking.

  • Graduated tokens only — the same tokens you can swap on the Swap page.
  • Graduation LP stays locked — it is permanently locked in the locker and cannot be moved or staked by anyone.
  • Your own LP is separate — LP you receive from the Liquidity page stays in your wallet and can be withdrawn there at any time; it is not part of farming.
